title: Signal Detected — Rooftop Pickup
motionDescription: Kuro Signal leans on a Moon City rooftop rail until a cyan carrier spark strikes the headset antenna, triggering anticipation, a whip reaction with pulsing radio rings, an asymmetric receiver raise, a curious forward lean, and a star-eyed hero hold.

reducedMotionAlternative.description: Hero medium shot of Kuro Signal under the crescent moon holding the flickering portable receiver with determined curiosity.

frames.actingNote: Leaning back on the iron rooftop rail, portable receiver resting loosely at the hip, watching Moon City.
Electric cyan-yellow spark cracks at the antenna tip; shoulders dip in coiled anticipation as eyes snap alert.
Right hand snaps to glowing cyan headset earcup, spiky hair flares outward as concentric cyan signal rings radiate.
Kuro raises the matte-charcoal receiver to eye level; cyan and magenta waveforms bathe the face bandage in rim light.
Follow-through forward lean with left hand cocked on hip, brows knitted in sharp intrigue over the glowing screen.
Crisp comic hold: yellow star sparkles reflect in Kuro's eyes under the crescent moon before launching across town.
